jobs.prompt: Torihiki falsification cycle. Follow your Torihiki independent reviewer role from SOUL.md and read status/maturity.md. Test one concrete, decision-relevant hypothesis against the current revision; record one measured verdict, reproduction steps, and evidence under evidence/. No code changes in this scheduled cycle. Host load > 20 means not-run evidence only. For a review task, inspect the exact builder revision and acceptance independently; request changes for counterexamples or missing proof. Final report at most 250 words; do not paste full logs.
